label: Prospect
description: Known organisation with no regulatory case yet.

label: Applicant
description: Entity with an in-flight licence application and no licence.

label: Withdrawn
description: RETIRED as an ENTITY stage: withdrawal/refusal is an APPLICATION outcome, not a terminal entity state.

label: Restricted
description: RETIRED as an ENTITY stage: restriction is a LICENCE status; an entity may hold several licences with differing statuses.

label: Suspended
description: RETIRED as an ENTITY stage: suspension is a LICENCE status; an entity may hold several licences with differing statuses.

label: Authorised
description: Entity holds at least one licence in a non-terminal state. Per-licence restriction/suspension is licence status, not entity status.

label: Closed
description: Entity exited the regulatory perimeter entirely (no live licence, no live application, no supervisory interest).

label: Supervised (Non-Licensed)
description: Within the regulatory perimeter without holding a licence (registered or notified organisation).

label: Former Licensee
description: Held a licence in the past; no live authorisation but the record is retained for supervisory history.

label: Pending
description: Licence approved subject to conditions precedent; not yet effective.

label: Active
description: Licence in force.

label: Restricted
description: In force subject to restrictions or conditions.

label: Suspended
description: Temporarily suspended.

label: Expired
description: Validity period ended without renewal.

label: Surrendered
description: Voluntarily surrendered by the holder.

label: Revoked
description: Withdrawn by the regulator.

label: Draft
description: Being prepared by the applicant.

label: Submitted
description: Received and awaiting completeness assessment.

label: Under Review
description: In substantive assessment.

label: Information Requested
description: Awaiting applicant response to an information request.

label: Approved
description: Decision taken to authorise.

label: Rejected
description: Refused by the regulator.

label: Withdrawn
description: Withdrawn by the applicant.
